title: Blood Coagulation Cascade (Clotting Factors & Fibrin Mesh)
quickSummary: Extrinsic (Factor III) & Intrinsic (Factor XII) pathways activate Factor X. Prothrombinase complex (Factor Xa, Va, Ca²⁺) converts Prothrombin to Thrombin, which cleaves Fibrinogen to Fibrin. Vitamin K is required for Factors II, VII, IX, X.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
BLOOD COAGULATION CASCADE
                                   │
         ┌─────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────┐
         ▼                                                   ▼
EXTRINSIC PATHWAY (Tissue Injury)                   INTRINSIC PATHWAY (Vascular Contact)
Traumatized Tissue releases                         Foreign Surface contact activates
Tissue Factor / Factor III                          Factor XII (Hageman Factor)
         │                                                   │
         └─────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────┘
                                   ▼
                   [ COMMON PATHWAY ACTIVATION ]
                       Factor X ──► Factor Xa
                                   │
              [ Prothrombinase / Thrombokinase Complex ]
              (Requires Factor Xa, Factor Va, Ca²⁺, Phospholipids)
                                   │
             Prothrombin (Factor II) ──► Thrombin (Factor IIa)
                                   │
             Fibrinogen (Factor I)  ──► Fibrin Monomer ──[Factor XIIIa + Ca²⁺]──► FIBRIN CLOT
conceptBreakdown.content:
Blood clotting (coagulation) is a protective enzyme cascade that transforms liquid blood into a gel-like coagulum to prevent hemorrhage upon vascular injury.

### Essential Clotting Factors
- **Factor I**: Fibrinogen (Soluble plasma protein)
- **Factor II**: Prothrombin (Vitamin K-dependent zymogen)
- **Factor III**: Tissue Thromboplastin / Tissue Factor
- **Factor IV**: Calcium Ions ($\text{Ca}^{2+}$) [ESSENTIAL FOR ALL CASCADE STEPS!]
- **Factor VIII**: Antihemophilic Factor A (Deficient in Hemophilia A)
- **Factor IX**: Christmas Factor / Antihemophilic Factor B (Deficient in Hemophilia B)
- **Factor XIII**: Fibrin Stabilizing Factor (Cross-links fibrin monomers)
- **Vitamin K Role**: Essential co-factor for hepatic synthesis of **Factors II, VII, IX, and X** (*Mnemonic: 2 + 7 = 9, then 10*).
